clear_device_cache: clear the torch device cache by calling empty_cache on the available accelerator backend
release_memory: release memory from torch tensors by setting them to None and clearing the device cache
should_reduce_batch_size: check if a runtime exception indicates an out-of-memory error on CUDA, XPU, CPU, or HPU
find_executable_batch_size: find the largest batch size that fits in memory by wrapping a function with an auto-reducing decorator
run_find_executable_batch_size: run a training function with automatic batch size reduction on out-of-memory exceptions
